text:
Amelia H.: follow-up from the adapter RFC: proposing a "light adapter" on edge nodes to translate v1 client payloads to the v2 shape. goals: keep CPU low, preserve streaming semantics, avoid a big proxy rewrite. comments?

Jordy: sounds promising. specifics: header-only vs small JSON transforms? what's expected latency bump? :eyes:

Amelia H.: header sniff + small transformations (rename fields, wrap single prompt into array, convert legacy batch into single stream frame). estimate p95 +2-6ms on edge. no model or upstream changes.

Devon: infra: ensure adapter runs before upstream pool selection to reuse keepalives. gate with env `EDGE_COMPAT_LIGHT_ADAPTER=true`.

Devon: local config snippet I tested:
```
edge.service.adapters.light_adapter.enabled = true
edge.service.adapters.light_adapter.routes = ["/v1/generate", "/v1/embeddings"]
```

Sara (SDK): SDK needs small opt-in change to set a compat header so rewrites are explicit. also add telemetry tag `compat=light-adapter`.

Amelia H.: agreed. adapter will add `X-Compat-Source: light-adapter-v1`. SDK will set `X-Compat-Client` during opt-in. will also surface `X-Deprecation` header later.

mike-sre: fallback policy? prefer fail-fast 400 for mapping mismatch, instrument `adapter.mapping_errors` metric and alert.

Amelia H.: error semantics: 400 for bad mapping, 503 for internal adapter errors with `Retry-After`. adapter will set `X-Compat-Error: mapping` when appropriate.

Jordy: streaming concerns: do we buffer then stream, or translate frames live?

Amelia H.: stream-translate where possible. for legacy batch endpoints emit a single stream frame instead of buffering whole model output on edge. avoid holding full output.

Devon: add perf safeguard: if per-frame translation blocks >100ms, fallback to buffered single-frame and increment `adapter.fallback_to_buffered`. circuit-breaker: if fallback >0.5% over 5m, throttle new adapter flows on route.

Sara (SDK): migration plan: week0 announce + guide; week1 opt-in SDK release setting `X-Compat-Client`; week2 enable 1% tenants via feature-flag; ramp to 100% over weeks 3-4 based on metrics; week5 send deprecation header `X-Deprecation: v1 removed in 90d`.

Amelia H.: key metrics: `adapter.latency.p95`, `adapter.error_rate`, `adapter.mapping_errors`, `upstream.latency.delta`, `sdk.clients_using_compat`. watch support tickets.

mike-sre: SRE guardrail: if adapter adds >10ms p95 for a route for 15m, auto-disable adapter for that route and page oncall. runbook: if `adapter.mapping_errors > 10/m` for 5m, run `edgectl adapters disable light_adapter --route /v1/generate` and notify #incidents.

ops-bot: deploy queued: edge/adapters/light-adapter v0.1 -> staging (sha: 7a3f9e).

Devon: I'll run a load test with 50k RPS small prompt traffic. observability ticket ENG-RUNTIME-612.

Amelia H.: owners + next steps: Amelia (design + rollout), Devon (infra + load tests), Sara (SDK release + docs), Mike (SRE + alerts). I'll publish an RFC addendum with mapping table and sample errors. target flip of 1% flag next Wed if no blockers.

Jordy: ok from me. please include curl example for support repro.

Amelia H.: repro example:
```
curl -i -X POST https://edge.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Compat-Client: sdk-v1-shim' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello", "max_tokens":16}'
```

Sara (SDK): I'll draft SDK note and compatibility FAQ. tagging me. :thumbsup:

mike-sre: will add runbook snippets and alerts prior to canary.

Amelia H.: I'll post the addendum and rollout schedule in #eng-runtime today.
